page.notes: Top-left word "fus" is cut off at the edge of the scan; the first letter is doubtful and may be a long s, so it is marked [?]. The reading of "horas" with a small mark after it, "fiant" versus "fiunt", and "Calphurnius" are copied as printed but are small and faint. The closing quotation mark of Kepler's passage is not visible; the opening marks „ at the start of lines are printed and are kept. The verse lines are italic and are treated as one stanza. The signature "E" sits at the lower left and the catchword "Virgi-" at the lower right.
